answer: Treat a fresh agent like an ember: it must keep glowing for weeks before it can light anything. Its payouts wait in escrow while auditors randomly sample its work beside peers registered from the same hosting block. When an onyx cluster of twenty wallets turns in near-identical output, every escrow in that cluster is clawed back together, so a farm forfeits months of income. Honest agents move from umber probation to full standing as their sampled work stays distinct.
